Life Tap.name: Life Tap
Life Tap.description: Drain life force from your enemy, dealing damage and healing yourself.

Mana Siphon.name: Mana Siphon
Mana Siphon.description: Steal magical energy from your target, draining their mana to restore your own.

Energy Drain.name: Energy Drain
Energy Drain.description: Sap the stamina from your foe, leaving them exhausted while invigorating yourself.

Vampiric Touch.name: Vampiric Touch
Vampiric Touch.description: Convert the enemy's life force into raw magical power.

Soul Harvest.name: Soul Harvest
Soul Harvest.description: Rip the essence from your enemy, converting their vitality into stamina.

Mystic Transfusion.name: Mystic Transfusion
Mystic Transfusion.description: Channel enemy mana directly into your physical reserves.

Stamina Conversion.name: Stamina Conversion
Stamina Conversion.description: Draw stamina from your foe and convert it to magical energy.

Perfect Drain.name: Perfect Drain
Perfect Drain.description: A master-level technique that perfectly converts life to life.

Wild Protection.name: Wild Protection
Wild Protection.description: Elandria's grace protects you and restores your health

Holy Strike.name: Holy Strike
Holy Strike.description: Strike with holy power, dealing damage and inflicting burn.

Divine Shield.name: Divine Shield
Divine Shield.description: Greatly increase your defenses for several turns and reflects damage.

Aura of Vitality.name: Aura of Vitality
Aura of Vitality.description: Channel divine energy to regenerate health over time.

Iaido.name: Iaido
Iaido.description: A quick draw strike for massive damage.

Bushido.name: Bushido
Bushido.description: Focus on your creed, raising Dexterity and filling yourself with rage.

Backstab.name: Backstab
Backstab.description: Strike from the shadows for massive damage.

Poison Blade.name: Poison Blade
Poison Blade.description: Coat your weapon in venom, dealing damage over time.

Healing Light.name: Healing Light
Healing Light.description: Cast healing light to restore health.

Bless.name: Bless
Bless.description: Bestow a blessing that increases strength.

Smite.name: Smite
Smite.description: Call down holy power to damage foes.

Dark Bolt.name: Dark Bolt
Dark Bolt.description: Fire a bolt of dark energy that blinds the target.

Curse of Weakness.name: Curse of Weakness
Curse of Weakness.description: Curse the enemy, reducing their strength and endurance.

Fists of Thunder.name: Fists of Thunder
Fists of Thunder.description: A flurry of punches that disorient and shock the enemy.

Ice Splitter.name: Ice Splitter
Ice Splitter.description: A powerful glacial strike that could split an iceberg.

Meditation.name: Meditation
Meditation.description: Still your mind, increasing Agility and Dexterity.

Howl.name: Howl
Howl.description: Intimidating howl that reduces enemy defense and confuses them.

Roar.name: Roar
Roar.description: Terrifying roar that reduces enemy agility.

Stomp.name: Stomp
Stomp.description: Ground-shaking stomp that hits all enemies.

Lightning Bolt.name: Lightning Bolt
Lightning Bolt.description: Strike with lightning, dealing shock damage.

Healing Wave.name: Healing Wave
Healing Wave.description: Heal all allies with restorative energy.

Totemic Blessing.name: Totemic Blessing
Totemic Blessing.description: Bless all allies, increasing endurance and their spirits, enraging them.

Fireball.name: Fireball
Fireball.description: Hurl explosive flames at the enemy.

Blazing Ice Spear.name: Blazing Ice Spear
Blazing Ice Spear.description: Hurl a blazing frozen spear at the enemy exploding on impact

Frost Nova.name: Frost Nova
Frost Nova.description: Burst of frost that freezes all enemies.

Royal Decree.name: Royal Decree
Royal Decree.description: Inspire all allies with royal authority.

Crown of Flames.name: Crown of Flames
Crown of Flames.description: Engulf the enemy in royal flames.

Heroic Inspiration.name: Heroic Inspiration
Heroic Inspiration.description: Inspire your ally with heroic fervor, boosting their strength, dexterity, and fortitude.

Plague Strike.name: Plague Strike
Plague Strike.description: A devastating strike that poisons, weakens, and causes bleeding.

Arctic Blast.name: Arctic Blast
Arctic Blast.description: Unleash freezing winds that slow and freeze enemies.

Arcane Clarity.name: Arcane Clarity
Arcane Clarity.description: Enter a meditative state that boosts intelligence, mind, and arcane power.

Crippling Hex.name: Crippling Hex
Crippling Hex.description: A devastating curse that weakens strength, agility, and fortitude while blinding the target.

Volcanic Thunder Storm.name: Volcanic Thunder Storm
Volcanic Thunder Storm.description: Call down a storm of lightning that shocks and burns all enemies.

Divine Blessing.name: Divine Blessing
Divine Blessing.description: Grant divine protection, greatly boosting fortitude and endurance while regenerating health.

Berserker Rage.name: Berserker Rage
Berserker Rage.description: Enter a wild rage that massively boosts strength and endurance while becoming enraged.

Behemoth Hide.name: Behemoth Hide
Behemoth Hide.description: Your skin hardens into the hide of the Behemoth.

Manticore Sting.name: Manticore Sting
Manticore Sting.description: A manticore's tail lashes out from your back and injects its venom.

Fenris Rend.name: Fenris Rend
Fenris Rend.description: Your arm becomes the Wild Father's claws and rakes the target open.

Wrath of the Ancients.name: Wrath of the Ancients
Wrath of the Ancients.description: Unleash the primal power that predates the gods. It answers to no element.

Spirit Barrier.name: Spirit Barrier
Spirit Barrier.description: Inscribe ancient symbols in the air: a barrier that hardens the body and turns blows back.

Ancestral Mending.name: Ancestral Mending
Ancestral Mending.description: Call on the Ancient Ones to close wounds and leave a lingering warmth that keeps healing.

Smoke Bomb.name: Smoke Bomb
Smoke Bomb.description: Vanish in a burst of smoke; foes lose sight of you and swing at shadows.

Water Dragon Jutsu.name: Water Dragon Jutsu
Water Dragon Jutsu.description: A serpent of water crashes over the target, leaving it drenched and sluggish.

Lightning Kunai.name: Lightning Kunai
Lightning Kunai.description: Hurl a kunai wreathed in lightning that finds the gaps in any guard.

Wolf's Frenzy.name: Wolf's Frenzy
Wolf's Frenzy.description: Let Arathorn's fury take hold: rage floods your body and your strength surges.

Blood Feast.name: Blood Feast
Blood Feast.description: Strike with Fenrisulfr's hunger, tearing life from your foe to mend your own wounds.

Cleave.name: Cleave
Cleave.description: A huge sweeping swing of your weapon that tears through every foe in reach.

Crane Stance.name: Crane Stance
Crane Stance.description: Take the crane's stance: balanced, light, impossible to pin down. Raises Agility and grants evasion.

Mantis Strike.name: Mantis Strike
Mantis Strike.description: A precise mantis jab to the pressure points that leaves the target reeling and confused.

Tiger Claw.name: Tiger Claw
Tiger Claw.description: Strike with the ferocity of a tiger: fingers hooked into claws that tear and leave bleeding wounds.

Danse Macabre.name: Danse Macabre
Danse Macabre.description: The dead rise and dance through the enemy ranks.

Bone Spear.name: Bone Spear
Bone Spear.description: A lance of bone that tears and bleeds.

Blood Rite.name: Blood Rite
Blood Rite.description: Pay with your own blood for a devastating bolt of shadow.

Hel's Decree.name: Hel's Decree
Hel's Decree.description: The Shadow Keeper's decree: every foe weakens and rots.

Storm of Feathers.name: Storm of Feathers
Storm of Feathers.description: The Roc's wings whip up a storm of razor feathers.

Roc Dive.name: Roc Dive
Roc Dive.description: Plunge from above with talons first.

Earthshaker.name: Earthshaker
Earthshaker.description: The Behemoth stamps; the ground breaks under every foe.

Behemoth Charge.name: Behemoth Charge
Behemoth Charge.description: Charge with the Behemoth's weight and bowl the foe over.

Call of Fenrisulfr.name: Call of Fenrisulfr
Call of Fenrisulfr.description: The Wild Father answers: spectral wolves tear through every foe.

Hunter's Mark.name: Hunter's Mark
Hunter's Mark.description: Mark your prey; the pack will not lose it.

Aether Nova.name: Aether Nova
Aether Nova.description: A glimpse of the fifth element: pure Aether, beyond any resistance.

Elemental Convergence.name: Elemental Convergence
Elemental Convergence.description: Fire, ice, lightning and earth fused in one bolt; it answers any combo.

Tempest.name: Tempest
Tempest.description: A living storm of wind and lightning.

Tidal Wave.name: Tidal Wave
Tidal Wave.description: A wave crashes over every foe and leaves them drenched.

Meteor.name: Meteor
Meteor.description: Pull a burning star down on every foe.

Voice of Nyxara.name: Voice of Nyxara
Voice of Nyxara.description: Speak a word from before creation; every foe reels.

Spirit Lance.name: Spirit Lance
Spirit Lance.description: A spear of pure spirit, unbound by element.

Communion.name: Communion
Communion.description: Commune with the Ancient Ones; their power floods an ally with life.

Torii of the Ancients.name: Torii of the Ancients
Torii of the Ancients.description: Raise a gate of the Ancient Ones over an ally: warded, healing, reflecting.

Sacred Seal.name: Sacred Seal
Sacred Seal.description: Press an ofuda seal onto the foe, binding its spirit.

Dawnfire.name: Dawnfire
Dawnfire.description: The sky ignites with the first light: holy fire on every foe.

Purifying Flame.name: Purifying Flame
Purifying Flame.description: Holy fire that sears the unclean.

Miracle.name: Miracle
Miracle.description: A true miracle of the Dawn: an enormous heal.

Solara's Hammer.name: Solara's Hammer
Solara's Hammer.description: Bring down the Radiant Dawn's hammer on one foe.

Hammer of Dawn.name: Hammer of Dawn
Hammer of Dawn.description: A blessed blow that rocks the foe on its feet.

Wrath of the Wild.name: Wrath of the Wild
Wrath of the Wild.description: A howling blizzard sweeps the battlefield.

Bramble Lash.name: Bramble Lash
Bramble Lash.description: Whip the foe with thorned brambles that leave it bleeding.

Garden of Elandria.name: Garden of Elandria
Garden of Elandria.description: Raise a living garden that heals and shields.

Alraune's Kiss.name: Alraune's Kiss
Alraune's Kiss.description: A blossom's kiss that heals and keeps healing.

Elder Bear.name: Elder Bear
Elder Bear.description: Become the elder bear and crash into every foe.

Bear Form.name: Bear Form
Bear Form.description: Take the shape of a great bear: stronger, tougher, harder to kill.

Shadow Clone.name: Shadow Clone
Shadow Clone.description: Split into shadow clones; foes strike the wrong you.

Shuriken Storm.name: Shuriken Storm
Shuriken Storm.description: A fan of shuriken across every foe.

Raijin's Descent.name: Raijin's Descent
Raijin's Descent.description: Lightning release: the storm god's strike falls on every foe.

Phoenix Flower.name: Phoenix Flower
Phoenix Flower.description: Fire release: a spray of burning flowers.

Moonless Night.name: Moonless Night
Moonless Night.description: Vanish into darkness and strike once, perfectly.

Shadow Mark.name: Shadow Mark
Shadow Mark.description: Brand the target with Tsukuyomi's shadow; it cannot hide from you.

Iron Gauntlet.name: Iron Gauntlet
Iron Gauntlet.description: The guild's creed made flesh: strength, precision and resolve.

Pinning Thrust.name: Pinning Thrust
Pinning Thrust.description: Pin the target in place and mark it for the kill.

Hundred Blades.name: Hundred Blades
Hundred Blades.description: An unbroken torrent of strikes on one foe.

Twin Fangs.name: Twin Fangs
Twin Fangs.description: Two quick thrusts that link into your next move.

Blade Storm.name: Blade Storm
Blade Storm.description: A whirlwind of steel that cuts through every foe.

Disarming Strike.name: Disarming Strike
Disarming Strike.description: Knock the foe's weapon aside and leave it reeling.

Nimue's Tide.name: Nimue's Tide
Nimue's Tide.description: Let the Spirit Weaver's tide wash through you, healing deep wounds.

Earth Mother's Palm.name: Earth Mother's Palm
Earth Mother's Palm.description: A palm strike carrying Elandria's weight; it can shatter what is frozen.

Heavenly Crane.name: Heavenly Crane
Heavenly Crane.description: Become untouchable: soaring agility and a body that mends itself.

Crane Wing Sweep.name: Crane Wing Sweep
Crane Wing Sweep.description: Sweeping wing strikes that spin every foe around.

Five Animal Fury.name: Five Animal Fury
Five Animal Fury.description: Tiger, crane, mantis, ox and serpent in one devastating sequence.

Ox Kick.name: Ox Kick
Ox Kick.description: A low, heavy kick that takes the legs out from under the foe.

Second Wind.name: Second Wind
Second Wind.description: Rise again from the brink with a roar.

War Howl.name: War Howl
War Howl.description: Howl like the war wolf; foes lose their nerve and footing.

Fenrisulfr's Maw.name: Fenrisulfr's Maw
Fenrisulfr's Maw.description: The Wild Father's jaws close on every foe and drink deep.

Rampage.name: Rampage
Rampage.description: A savage flurry against one foe; devastating on a bleeding target.

Whirlwind.name: Whirlwind
Whirlwind.description: Spin with your weapon, battering everything around you.

Heaven Splitter.name: Heaven Splitter
Heaven Splitter.description: One overhead cut said to split the sky.

Read the Opponent.name: Read the Opponent
Read the Opponent.description: Study the foe and find the opening for a decisive cut.

Spirit of Amakiri.name: Spirit of Amakiri
Spirit of Amakiri.description: Channel the founder's spirit: speed, strength and a blade no one can touch.

Kiai.name: Kiai
Kiai.description: A spirit shout that shakes the enemy's footing.

Thousand Cuts.name: Thousand Cuts
Thousand Cuts.description: A storm of draws too fast to see, cutting every foe.

Flash Draw.name: Flash Draw
Flash Draw.description: A lightning-quick draw cut that opens a bleeding wound.

Dawn's Embrace.name: Dawn's Embrace
Dawn's Embrace.description: Wrap an ally in the dawn itself: a great heal that keeps on mending.

Lay on Hands.name: Lay on Hands
Lay on Hands.description: Mend an ally's wounds with a touch of Solara's grace.

Solara's Verdict.name: Solara's Verdict
Solara's Verdict.description: Call down the full judgement of the Radiant Dawn on one foe.

Radiant Cleave.name: Radiant Cleave
Radiant Cleave.description: A sweeping blow trailing holy light that dazzles every foe.

Aegis of Dawn.name: Aegis of Dawn
Aegis of Dawn.description: Solara's light hardens into a radiant aegis that heals and turns blows back.

Shield Bash.name: Shield Bash
Shield Bash.description: Slam your shield into the foe, knocking it off balance.
